subject: Keepsafe pilot: request for short buffer while PO clears
messages:
From: Lucy Tran <lucy@keepsafe.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Jul 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Keepsafe pilot - procurement delay, can you help keep sandbox live?

Hi Camila,

Quick note — our procurement team just told me the PO that will cover the pilot is pushed into finance review and likely won’t be fully approved until the first week of August (looks like 5 Aug at the earliest). Our pilot environment and the trial tokens are set to expire on 1 Aug, which would interrupt the demo for the clinical team.

Is there any way Redwood can keep the sandbox live or issue a short-term token grant until the PO clears? We’re committed to moving forward — legal & IT are just on a slow cadence right now. If needed I can loop in procurement but wanted to check with you first.

Usage to date: ~55k tokens over two weeks (mostly reranking + embeddings + a couple of generation heavy flows). We expect another ~30–80k tokens before the pilot wraps depending on the next week’s activity.

Thanks for any help here — we’d like to avoid a hard stop if possible.

Best,
Lucy
Lucy Tran
Product Manager, Keepsafe Therapeutics
[Attachment: pilot_scope_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Tran <lucy@keepsafe.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Keepsafe pilot - procurement delay, can you help keep sandbox live?

Hi Lucy — thanks for the heads up and the usage breakdown, that’s helpful.

We can absolutely help avoid a disruption while procurement finishes. A couple quick Qs so I can get internal approval faster:
- When do you expect the PO number / signed SOW to be available (date estimate is fine)?
- Any compliance/legal blockers we should be aware of (e.g., additional DPA clauses, data residency)?

Provisional offer: I can provision a 7-day token buffer (up to 50k tokens) immediately to keep things running while we finalize. If you anticipate needing more runway, tell me the target window and I’ll escalate for a larger buffer.

I’ve attached the latest pilot scope so nothing gets out of sync. If you can confirm the expected PO clear date we’ll push this through.

Camila Reyes
Account Executive — Strategic Pilots
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pilot_scope_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]

From: Lucy Tran <lucy@keepsafe.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 27 Jul 2027 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Keepsafe pilot - procurement delay, can you help keep sandbox live?

Thanks Camila — appreciate the quick reply.

PO estimate is 5 Aug. Legal might still ask for a brief addendum to the DPA but nothing we expect to block the PO from being issued the week of the 2nd. Given that timeline, would Redwood consider a 14-day buffer (we need to support a scheduled clinical walkthrough on 9 Aug)? 50k will likely run out before that.

We’re happy to accept a conditional extension: Keepsafe will provide the PO as soon as it’s available; if the PO doesn’t materialize within the buffer window we understand any credits would be reversed.

Let me know what you can do and we’ll get procurement to prioritize the PO.

—Lucy
Lucy Tran
Product Manager, Keepsafe Therapeutics
procurement@keepsafe.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Keepsafe (KD-3194) — request: 14-day, 100k token provisional credit while PO clears

Aditya / Marissa —

Keepsafe Therapeutics (KD-3194) is asking for a short buffer while procurement finishes. Customer committed to pilot expansion if the clinical walkthrough goes well; ARR upside modest but strategic (payer-facing demo set). Current usage is ~55k tokens and they’ll probably consume ~60–100k additional tokens before Aug 9 if we keep the environment live.

Request: provision a time-limited 14-day credit for up to 100k tokens (start immediately) with the following conditions:
- Customer must provide PO/SOW within the 14-day window (expected by 2027-08-05).
- If no PO is received at the end of window, credits will be revoked and any incurred overages invoiced per standard rates.
- Legal can require a short addendum if DPA changes are needed.

Attachments: internal_pricing_deck_v1.pdf (for visibility).

Recommendation: approve — keeps pilot momentum for the clinical team and reduces risk of churn; low credit exposure (~$350-$600 estimated cost at current config) and high chance of conversion.

Thanks,
Camila

[Attachment: internal_pricing_deck_v1.pdf (PDF, 200KB)]

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Keepsafe (KD-3194) — request: 14-day, 100k token provisional credit while PO clears

Thanks Camila — I approve the 14-day, 100k token provisional credit under the conditions you listed. Please include a short note in the deal record that this is conditional on PO/SOW receipt by 2027-08-05 and that credits are revocable. Also mark this as a credit waiver in finance with ally code: CW-2027-07-KD3194.

Aditya Rao
Head of Sales — East
Redwood Inference

[Internal: ensure finance is copied when the credit is applied so accounting can track the waiver.]

From: Camila Reyes <camila_reyes@redwood.ai>
To: Lucy Tran <lucy@keepsafe.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 31 Jul 2027 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Keepsafe pilot - procurement delay, can you help keep sandbox live?

Hi Lucy — good news: we can grant a one-time, conditional 14-day extension and a 100k-token provisional credit to keep your sandbox live. Terms:
- Window: 2027-07-31 through 2027-08-13 (14 days).
- Credit cap: 100,000 tokens.
- Condition: Keepsafe must provide the PO/SOW by 2027-08-05. If PO is not received by then, we will revoke the remaining credits and invoice any usage outside standard trial allowances.

I’ve added the notes to the HubSpot deal (KD-3194) and attached the pilot scope for reference. You should be all set for the clinical walkthrough on 9 Aug — please confirm and I’ll send over a short confirmation letter for signatures if legal needs it.

Links: HubSpot deal — https://hub.redwood.ai/deals/KD-3194

Thanks — looking forward to the walkthrough.

Best,
Camila Reyes
Account Executive — Strategic Pilots
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: pilot_scope_v2.pdf (PDF, 120KB)]
